title: setup_approvals_preserved
description: No SavingsDai method revokes sDAI's Vat hope for DaiJoin or Pot, or lowers its DAI allowance to DaiJoin below type(uint256).max (both set up by the constructor).

title: owner_can_always_redeem
description: Given a live Maker system (DaiJoin.live == 1, sDAI's constructor approvals in place, Pot authorised on the Vat, Pot's Vat balance covering sDAI's pie, dsr >= RAY), an owner's redeem of their whole balance and withdraw of maxWithdraw never revert.

title: redeem_does_not_depend_on_drip
description: Probe: owners can redeem even when Pot.drip would revert (e.g. dsr < RAY). Expected to expose that sDAI withdrawals require a successful drip whenever rho < now, while direct Pot users can still exit.

title: deposit_liveness
description: Under the same live-system assumptions, deposit(assets, receiver) by a caller with enough DAI balance and allowance to sDAI does not revert for a valid receiver.

title: vault_never_pays_rounding_from_own_vat_balance
description: No deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem decreases sDAI's own Vat dai balance: rounding dust always accrues to the vault, never drains it.
